!!! note "Launchers & the Alt+Space clash"
    **Raycast** (Microsoft Store, id `9PFXXSHC64H3`) is the default launcher.
    It shares **Alt+Space** with **PowerToys Run** — disable PowerToys Run
    (PowerToys Settings › PowerToys Run › off) or rebind one. Raycast for Windows
    is still a Store beta; if it won't install, fall back to
    [Flow Launcher](https://www.flowlauncher.com/):
    `winget install Flow-Launcher.Flow-Launcher`.

!!! note "Notepad++ is opt-in"
    Dropped from the default set: on Windows-on-ARM its installer is a
    low-reputation binary that Windows Defender / SmartScreen flags as PUA
    (a false positive, aggravated by managed-machine PUA protection), and it's
    redundant with VSCode / Cursor / nvim. Add it yourself if you want it:
    `winget install Notepad++.Notepad++` or `scoop install notepadplusplus`.

!!! note "Managed / corporate machines"
    The **Managed machine** init toggle skips apps that org policy commonly
    blocks — **Grammarly** and **Tailscale** (its MSI fails with exit `1625`
    under policy). Leave the toggle off on a personal machine to install them.

!!! note "Alacritty & Nerd Fonts (machine-wide install)"
    scoop's `nerd-fonts` bucket registers **Hack Nerd Font Mono** *per-user*
    (HKCU). Windows Terminal and WezTerm see per-user fonts, but **Alacritty on
    Windows reads only the machine-wide font collection**, so it can't find the
    font and falls back to a default. Fix (needs admin):
    `just install-fonts-machine-wide` (runs `scoop install -g Hack-NF-Mono Hack-NF`),
    then restart Alacritty. Diagnose the family name with
    `[System.Drawing.FontFamily]::Families.Name | Select-String Hack`.

## AI agents

Enabled by **Install coding agents**:

- **Claude Code** — `Anthropic.ClaudeCode` via **winget** (the native Windows
  build; distinct from `Anthropic.Claude`, the desktop app under GUI apps).
  Upgraded with `just upgrade-winget`, not npm.
- **OpenCode** (`opencode-ai`), **Codex** (`@openai/codex`), **Copilot CLI**
  (`@github/copilot`) — installed globally via **npm** (provided by the scoop `node`).
  On a corporate machine, npm may use an internal pull-through mirror because
  `registry.npmjs.org` is blocked. npm honours that configured registry; Bun does
  not, so `copilot-proxy` prefers npm for its private prefix. Diagnose the mirror
  with `npm view <package>@<version> version`, not `npm ping`; the matching
  symptom records are `copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module`
  and `packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path` under `pitfalls/`.
- **Codex native footer** — chezmoi non-destructively merges a provider-neutral
  status line (model/reasoning, fast mode, branch, context, tasks, directory)
  into `~/.codex/config.toml`. No fork or PATH shim; see
  [Codex status line](codex-status-line.md).
- **OpenCode Desktop** — GUI companion to the `opencode-ai` CLI, via scoop
  (`extras/opencode-desktop`).
- **claude-hud** — a statusline HUD below the Claude Code prompt. One
  `run_onchange` merger (`.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_25_claude_settings.ps1.tmpl`)
  independently deep-merges `~/.claude/settings.json` and the stable
  `~/.claude/plugins/claude-hud/config.json`, preserving live-only state in each.
  The latter enforces the managed **Full policy for claude-hud 0.8.0**: English
  labels, Expanded layout, a non-compact usage bar, activity plus
  token/usage/cost/speed/session timestamps/memory/cache/version indicators, and
  Git/Jujutsu state. Custom text, auth/provider fields, ordering, colors,
  thresholds, time/model formatting, external usage paths and future keys remain
  user-owned. The optional `~/.claude/claude-hud.json` per-config override is
  never touched and can intentionally shadow the managed base. The plugin
  self-installs from its marketplace on first launch; its guarded Git Bash
  status-line command runs with scoop's `node` and silently no-ops until the
  plugin cache exists. The settings overlay also enables
  `pyright-lsp` and sets `permissions.defaultMode: auto` plus
  `skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt`. **Restart Claude Code** after
  `chezmoi apply` to load a newly installed plugin. See
  [running multiple agents](claude-code-agents.md).
- **Desktop notifications** — `apprise` (`uv tool install --with pywin32 apprise`)
  fires native Windows toasts on Claude Code's **Notification** (needs your
  attention) and **Stop** (task finished) events, via a native-pwsh hook
  (`~/.claude/hooks/notify.ps1`) the settings overlay wires into `hooks`. Routing
  lives in `~/.config/apprise/apprise.yaml` — the `windows://` backend tagged
  `desktop`; add your own remote services (Discord/Slack/…) in the create-once
  `~/.config/apprise/custom.yaml`. Port of the parent repo's `notify.sh` +
  `apprise.yaml`.

The official **ChatGPT** desktop app installs via the Microsoft Store (see GUI
apps); **Codex** is the `@openai/codex` npm CLI above, not a Store app. SpecStory
has no native-Windows CLI package, so it's omitted here — an experimental build
from the unmerged PR #191 is opt-in via the **SpecStory build** init prompt
(`installSpecstoryBuild`) or `just specstory-build` (needs git + go).

## PowerShell modules (PSGallery)

- **PSFzf** — fzf key bindings (Ctrl+t files, Ctrl+r history).
- **AudioDeviceCmdlets** — absolute volume + mute for the `sysvol`/`sysmute` helpers.

## Opt-in dev stacks

Off by default; enable the matching init prompt:

| Toggle | Installs |
|---|---|
| Local LLM tools | Ollama (`Ollama.Ollama`) + LiteLLM (`uv tool install 'litellm[proxy]'`) |
| Tunnel tools | ngrok, cloudflared (scoop) |
| IaC tools | Terraform, OpenTofu (scoop) + Azure CLI & the `azure-devops` extension (`az devops`/`az repos`, winget) |
| OpenSSH server | Microsoft OpenSSH Server (sshd): Windows capability + auto-start service + inbound TCP 22 firewall rule, with pwsh as the default shell. Needs admin — set up on an elevated `chezmoi apply`, or run `just enable-sshd` from an elevated pwsh. |
| herdr multiplexer | herdr, a native Windows terminal multiplexer (**preview beta**). No scoop/winget manifest — installs via herdr.dev's `irm \| iex` script; config managed at `~/.config/herdr/config.toml` (pwsh as the default shell). Every apply also exports the official skill from the installed binary's `herdr --skill` output into both `~/.agents/skills/herdr/` and `~/.claude/skills/herdr/`, keeping preview-version instructions aligned. Also installs the [herdr-plus](https://github.com/cloudmanic/herdr-plus) plugin that backs `prefix+y` (Quick Actions) and `prefix+O` (Projects) — **needs `go`** (its Windows build is `go build`), so it is skipped with a message when go is absent (`scoop install go`, or enable *Extra runtimes*). See [rationale](rationale.md#terminal-multiplexer-wezterm-stable-default-herdr-native-beta). |
| Clink (cmd.exe) | [Clink](https://chrisant996.github.io/clink/) (scoop `main`) — Bash-style line editing for `cmd.exe`, so **starship** + **zoxide** + **fzf** work in the DOS prompt. Reuses the shared `starship.toml`; registers a per-user cmd AutoRun, deploys our `starship.lua`, and fetches the community `clink-zoxide` / `clink-fzf` bridges into `%LocalAppData%\clink`. pwsh stays the default — this is an opt-in secondary shell with prompt + nav parity only. See [rationale](rationale.md#powershell-7-default-cmdexe-optional-via-clink) & [Shell](shell.md#cmdexe-via-clink). |
| try (ephemeral workspaces) | [`try`](https://github.com/tobi/try) via `gem install try-cli` (ruby installed if absent). Dated `~/src/tries/YYYY-MM-DD-name` trial dirs + a fuzzy selector; `tri <git-url>` clones into one. The pwsh command is **`tri`** (`try` is a reserved keyword — bareword `try` won't parse; `& try` works). See [Shell](shell.md#try). |
| translate (on for workstation) | [`translate`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/translate) — terminal translator (CLI + TUI) over copilot-proxy / Ollama / Google plus an offline CC-CEDICT + ECDICT dictionary. No scoop/winget manifest and no prebuilt Windows release, so it is built from source with `go install` (go is installed by the block itself, so *Extra runtimes* need not be on) into `~\.local\bin`; the **first build takes several minutes**. Ships pwsh tab-completion and the `translate` tv channel. See [translate](translate.md). |
| Rime input method | [Weasel / 小狼毫](https://github.com/rime/weasel) (`Rime.Weasel`), Rime for Windows, registered as **Traditional Chinese**. Machine-scope NSIS installer, so applying raises a **UAC prompt**. The `*.custom.yaml` under `%APPDATA%\Rime` is chezmoi-managed and the engine-level part is **shared byte-for-byte with the macOS/Linux repo** (Squirrel / ibus-rime). See [Input method](input-method.md). |

## Package registries

One shared policy is applied both at install time and in interactive shells
(`profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`):

- **Managed machines** route pip/uv through the company PyPI pull-through
  registry and npm through the company npm pull-through registry. The PyPI path
  was verified with `tomlkit==0.13.3`; its artifacts are served by the corporate
  Azure Artifacts backend. IT already provisions the enabled company NuGet source
  and disables nuget.org, so the dotfiles do not rewrite NuGet configuration.
- **China mirrors** apply only on non-managed machines and route pip / npm / cargo /
  go / node through Tsinghua / npmmirror / goproxy.cn / rsproxy.
- No company Go or Cargo registry was discovered, so managed machines leave those
  ecosystems at their existing defaults.

The managed-machine policy wins if both toggles are true. This prevents a GFW
mirror from bypassing corporate package policy.

## Television (tv) channels

Custom pickers under `%APPDATA%\television\cable\` (run `tv` to browse, or `tv <name>`):

| Channel | What |
|---|---|
| `aliases` | PowerShell aliases & functions (cached at shell startup) |
| `git-ops` | common git commands → Enter copies to clipboard |
| `ports` | listening TCP ports → Ctrl+K kills the owning process |
| `kill-process` | processes by memory → Enter/Ctrl+K kill, Ctrl+D force-kill |
| `scoop-apps` | installed scoop apps → Enter info, Ctrl+U update, Ctrl+X uninstall |
| `apps` | launch an app from Start Menu shortcuts |
| `channels` | browse every tv channel by description → Enter opens the selected one |
| `translate` | translation history → Enter copies the translation, Ctrl+Y the original, Ctrl+S speaks it (opt-in `translate`) |

## Upgrades

Install and upgrade are separate. `chezmoi apply` only installs what's missing;
upgrades are explicit:

```powershell
just upgrade-scoop     # scoop update *
just upgrade-winget    # winget upgrade --all
just upgrade-npm-agents # close OpenCode/Codex/Copilot first (Windows locks live executables)
just upgrade-herdr     # herdr update --handoff + matching global skill
just upgrade-translate # go install …/translate@latest (opt-in tool; not in `just upgrade`)
```

**Docker Desktop 的 WSL2 後端**（`installWsl` 開關，workstation 預設開）由

平台、不裝 Linux 發行版（Docker 會自建 `docker-desktop` distro）。`wsl --install`

若要重跑或重試（例如 UAC 被拒），執行 `just enable-wsl`；已安裝的機器則為 no-op（不跳

shell* 仍不在此 repo 範圍 —— 見
[rationale](rationale.zh-TW.md#powershell-7-cmdexe-clink)。

**無人值守的 WSL Ubuntu + dotfiles**（`installWslUbuntu`，預設關）更進一步：
`scripts/enable-wsl-ubuntu.ps1` 註冊 `Ubuntu-24.04` 且**跳過 OOBE**（用 `wsl -u root`
建立使用者、免密碼 sudo、WSL 自動登入），接著在預設的 `headless` 模式下執行一條**從
Windows 凍結**的 chezmoi 指令，把跨平台 dotfiles（`daviddwlee84/dotfiles`，
`ubuntu_server` profile）裝進去，WSL 內完全不用回答提問。`wslUbuntuBootstrap` 也可設為
`interactive`（首次登入時跑父 repo 的提問）或 `none`（只建發行版）。需先有 WSL2 平台
（`installWsl`）並重開機；用 `just enable-wsl-ubuntu` 執行或重試。若日後把凍結的 profile
改成 `ubuntu_desktop`，Linux GUI app 透過 **WSLg** 直接可用。這是選用的*橋接* —— Linux
設定本身仍屬跨平台 repo，不在這裡。

    scoop 的 `nerd-fonts` bucket 是把 **Hack Nerd Font Mono** 註冊在*使用者層級*
    （HKCU）。Windows Terminal 與 WezTerm 看得到使用者字型，但 **Windows 上的
    Alacritty 只讀 machine-wide 字型集**，因此找不到字型、退回預設。修法（需系統
    管理員）：`just install-fonts-machine-wide`（執行 `scoop install -g Hack-NF-Mono
    Hack-NF`），再重啟 Alacritty。用
    `[System.Drawing.FontFamily]::Families.Name | Select-String Hack` 診斷字型家族名。

## AI agents

由 **Install coding agents** 啟用：

- **Claude Code** —— `Anthropic.ClaudeCode`，透過 **winget** 安裝（原生 Windows
  版；與 GUI 應用程式中的桌面程式 `Anthropic.Claude` 不同）。以
  `just upgrade-winget` 升級，不再走 npm。
- **OpenCode**（`opencode-ai`）、**Codex**（`@openai/codex`）、**Copilot CLI**
  （`@github/copilot`）—— 透過 **npm** 全域安裝（由 scoop 的 `node` 提供）。
  公司機器可能因 `registry.npmjs.org` 被封鎖而使用內部 pull-through mirror。npm 會遵守
  設定的 registry，Bun 不會，因此 `copilot-proxy` 優先以 npm 安裝到自己的 prefix。
  用 `npm view <package>@<version> version` 診斷 mirror，不要用 `npm ping`；對應的
  symptom record 是 `pitfalls/` 下的
  `copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module` 與
  `packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path`。
- **Codex 原生 footer** —— chezmoi 以非破壞性 overlay 把 provider-neutral
  status line（model/reasoning、fast mode、branch、context、tasks、directory）合併到
  `~/.codex/config.toml`；不裝 fork 或 PATH shim。見
  [Codex status line](codex-status-line.zh-TW.md)。
- **OpenCode Desktop** —— `opencode-ai` CLI 的 GUI 版，由 scoop 安裝
  （`extras/opencode-desktop`）。
- **claude-hud** —— 顯示在 Claude Code 輸入框下方的狀態列 HUD。同一個
  `run_onchange` 合併腳本（`.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_25_claude_settings.ps1.tmpl`）
  會彼此獨立地深度合併 `~/.claude/settings.json` 與穩定路徑
  `~/.claude/plugins/claude-hud/config.json`，各自保留只存在於 live 檔的狀態。後者會
  強制套用 **claude-hud 0.8.0 的受管 Full policy**：英文標籤、Expanded 版面、非 compact
  usage bar、活動資訊，以及 token/usage/cost/speed/session 時間戳、memory/cache/version
  與 Git/Jujutsu 狀態。自訂文字、auth/provider、排序、色彩、threshold、時間/model 格式、
  external usage path 與未來新增的 key 仍由使用者擁有。選用的
  `~/.claude/claude-hud.json` per-config override 永遠不會被修改，並可刻意遮蔽受管 base。
  外掛會在首次啟動時從 marketplace 自動安裝；受 guard 保護的 Git Bash status-line
  command 使用 scoop 的 `node`，在 plugin cache 尚未出現前會安靜地 no-op。
  settings overlay 也會啟用 `pyright-lsp`，並設定 `permissions.defaultMode: auto` 與
  `skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt`。執行 `chezmoi apply` 後請**重啟 Claude Code**以載入
  新安裝的外掛。參見[同時執行多個代理](claude-code-agents.zh-TW.md)。
- **桌面通知** —— `apprise`（`uv tool install --with pywin32 apprise`）在 Claude
  Code 的 **Notification**（需要你注意）與 **Stop**（任務完成）事件時，透過原生
  pwsh hook（`~/.claude/hooks/notify.ps1`，由 settings overlay 寫入 `hooks`）
  彈出原生 Windows toast。路由設定於 `~/.config/apprise/apprise.yaml` —— 標記為
  `desktop` 的 `windows://` 後端；自己的遠端服務（Discord/Slack/…）請加在只建立一次
  的 `~/.config/apprise/custom.yaml`。移植自上游 repo 的 `notify.sh` + `apprise.yaml`。

官方 **ChatGPT** 桌面程式透過 Microsoft Store 安裝（見 GUI 應用程式）；**Codex**
是上面的 `@openai/codex` npm CLI，不是 Store app。SpecStory 沒有原生 Windows CLI
套件，故此處略過 —— 從尚未合併的 PR #191 建置的實驗性版本可透過 **SpecStory build**
初始化提問（`installSpecstoryBuild`）或 `just specstory-build` 選用啟用（需 git + go）。

## PowerShell 模組（PSGallery）

- **PSFzf** —— fzf 快捷鍵（Ctrl+t 找檔案、Ctrl+r 歷史）。
- **AudioDeviceCmdlets** —— 提供 `sysvol`/`sysmute` 的絕對音量與靜音控制。

## 選用開發套件

預設關閉；開啟對應的 init 提問即安裝：

| 開關 | 安裝內容 |
|---|---|
| Local LLM tools | Ollama（`Ollama.Ollama`）+ LiteLLM（`uv tool install 'litellm[proxy]'`） |
| Tunnel tools | ngrok、cloudflared（scoop） |
| IaC tools | Terraform、OpenTofu（scoop）+ Azure CLI 與 `azure-devops` 擴充（`az devops`/`az repos`,winget） |
| OpenSSH server | Microsoft OpenSSH Server（sshd）：Windows capability + 自動啟動服務 + inbound TCP 22 防火牆規則，並以 pwsh 為預設 shell。需系統管理員 —— 用提升權限的 `chezmoi apply`，或在提升權限的 pwsh 執行 `just enable-sshd`。 |
| herdr multiplexer | herdr，原生 Windows 終端多工器（**preview beta**）。沒有 scoop/winget manifest —— 透過 herdr.dev 的 `irm \| iex` 腳本安裝；設定受管於 `~/.config/herdr/config.toml`（以 pwsh 為預設 shell）。每次 apply 也會從目前 binary 的 `herdr --skill` 輸出官方 skill，寫入 `~/.agents/skills/herdr/` 與 `~/.claude/skills/herdr/`，確保 preview 版本的指令一致。同時會安裝 [herdr-plus](https://github.com/cloudmanic/herdr-plus) 外掛，支撐 `prefix+y`（Quick Actions）與 `prefix+O`（Projects）—— 它**需要 `go`**（Windows 端用 `go build` 編譯），沒有 go 時會顯示訊息並跳過（`scoop install go`，或開啟「Extra runtimes」）。見 [rationale](rationale.zh-TW.md#wezterm-herdr-beta)。 |
| Clink (cmd.exe) | [Clink](https://chrisant996.github.io/clink/)（scoop `main`）—— cmd.exe 的 Bash 風格行編輯，讓 **starship** + **zoxide** + **fzf** 也能用在 DOS 提示字元。沿用共用的 `starship.toml`；註冊使用者層級 cmd AutoRun、部署我們的 `starship.lua`，並把社群的 `clink-zoxide` / `clink-fzf` 橋接抓進 `%LocalAppData%\clink`。pwsh 仍是預設 —— 這是選用的次要 shell，只有 prompt + 導覽對等。見 [rationale](rationale.zh-TW.md#powershell-7-cmdexe-clink) 與 [Shell](shell.zh-TW.md#cmdexe-via-clink)。 |
| try（暫時性 workspace） | [`try`](https://github.com/tobi/try)，透過 `gem install try-cli` 安裝（若無 ruby 會一併裝）。建立以日期命名的 `~/src/tries/YYYY-MM-DD-name` 試驗目錄 + 模糊選擇器；`tri <git-url>` 會 clone 進其中一個。pwsh 指令是 **`tri`**（`try` 是保留字 —— 裸打 `try` 無法 parse；`& try` 可用）。見 [Shell](shell.zh-TW.md#try)。 |
| translate（workstation 預設開） | [`translate`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/translate) —— 終端機翻譯工具（CLI + TUI），走 copilot-proxy / Ollama / Google，另有離線的 CC-CEDICT + ECDICT 辭典。它沒有 scoop/winget manifest，也沒有預先編譯的 Windows release，所以用 `go install` 從原始碼編進 `~\.local\bin`（go 由該區塊自己裝，不必開「Extra runtimes」）；**第一次編譯要好幾分鐘**。附帶 pwsh tab 補全與 `translate` tv channel。見 [translate](translate.zh-TW.md)。 |
| Rime 輸入法 | [小狼毫 / Weasel](https://github.com/rime/weasel)（`Rime.Weasel`），Windows 版 Rime，註冊為**繁體中文**。winget manifest 是 machine-scope NSIS，套用時會跳 **UAC**。`%APPDATA%\Rime` 下的 `*.custom.yaml` 由 chezmoi 納管，其中引擎層設定與 macOS/Linux repo（鼠鬚管 / ibus-rime）**逐位元組共用**。見 [輸入法](input-method.zh-TW.md)。 |

## 套件 registry

套用時的 installer 與互動式 shell（`profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`）共用同一份政策：

- **受管機器**的 pip/uv 走公司 PyPI pull-through registry，npm 走公司 npm
  pull-through registry。PyPI 路徑已用 `tomlkit==0.13.3` 驗證，artifact 由公司
  Azure Artifacts backend 提供。NuGet 的公司 source 與停用 nuget.org 已由 IT
  machine-wide 配置，因此 dotfiles 不覆寫 NuGet 設定。
- **China mirrors** 只在非受管機器生效，把 pip / npm / cargo / go / node 導向
  清華 / npmmirror / goproxy.cn / rsproxy。
- 未找到公司的 Go 或 Cargo registry，因此受管機器保留這兩者既有預設值。

若兩個 toggle 同時為 true，受管機器政策優先，避免 GFW mirror 繞過公司套件政策。

## Television（tv）channels

自訂選擇器放在 `%APPDATA%\television\cable\`（執行 `tv` 瀏覽，或 `tv <name>`）：

| Channel | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `aliases` | PowerShell aliases 與函式（shell 啟動時快取） |
| `git-ops` | 常用 git 指令 → Enter 複製到剪貼簿 |
| `ports` | 監聽中的 TCP ports → Ctrl+K 結束佔用的行程 |
| `kill-process` | 依記憶體排序的行程 → Enter/Ctrl+K 結束、Ctrl+D 強制結束 |
| `scoop-apps` | 已安裝的 scoop apps → Enter 資訊、Ctrl+U 更新、Ctrl+X 移除 |
| `apps` | 從開始功能表捷徑啟動應用程式 |
| `channels` | 依描述瀏覽所有 tv channel → Enter 開啟選定的 channel |
| `translate` | 翻譯歷史 → Enter 複製譯文、Ctrl+Y 複製原文、Ctrl+S 朗讀（選用的 `translate`） |

## 升級

安裝與升級刻意分開。`chezmoi apply` 只安裝缺少的東西；升級要明確執行：

```powershell
just upgrade-scoop     # scoop update *
just upgrade-winget    # winget upgrade --all
just upgrade-npm-agents # 請先關閉 OpenCode/Codex/Copilot（Windows 會鎖住執行中的 executable）
just upgrade-herdr     # herdr update --handoff + 對應版本的全域 skill
just upgrade-translate # go install …/translate@latest（選用工具，不含在 `just upgrade` 裡）
```
```

42	# Follow a file symlink without requiring its target to exist yet. This keeps a

44	function Resolve-JsonTargetPath {
45	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path)
46	
47	    $targetPath = $Path
48	    $seen = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
49	    while ($true) {
50	        $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $targetPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
51	        if (-not $item -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -eq 0) {
52	            return $targetPath
53	        }
54	        if (-not $seen.Add($item.FullName)) { throw "symbolic-link cycle while resolving $Path" }
55	        $resolved = $item.ResolveLinkTarget($false)

63	function Read-JsonObject {
64	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path)

66	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return @{} }

72	        $offset = 3
73	    }

121	# Serialize once, validate the candidate, then replace through a same-directory
122	# temporary file. Existing normalized bytes are left untouched for idempotence.
123	function Write-JsonObjectAtomically {
124	    param(
125	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path,
126	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [System.Collections.IDictionary] $Value,
127	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [bool] $ExpectedExists,
128	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [AllowEmptyCollection()] [byte[]] $ExpectedBytes
129	    )
130	
131	    $json = $Value | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 32 -ErrorAction Stop
132	    $json = $json.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n").TrimEnd([char[]] "`r`n") + "`n"
133	    $utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true)
134	    [byte[]] $candidate = $utf8.GetBytes($json)
135	
136	    $targetPath = Resolve-JsonTargetPath -Path $Path
137	
138	    $directory = Split-Path -Parent $targetPath
139	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $directory -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
140	    $temporary = Join-Path $directory ('.' + [IO.Path]::GetFileName($targetPath) + '.tmp.' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
141	    $backup = "$temporary.backup"
142	    $guard = $null
143	    try {
144	        [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($temporary, $candidate)
145	        $null = Read-JsonObject -Path $temporary
146	
147	        $currentExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $targetPath
148	        if ($currentExists -ne $ExpectedExists) {
149	            throw "$Path changed while the managed overlay was being prepared"
150	        }
151	        if ($currentExists) {
152	            # Deny ordinary readers/writers while allowing ReplaceFile's rename.
153	            # Compare through the held handle, then keep it open through the
154	            # atomic replacement so the precondition and commit share one guard.
155	            $guard = [IO.File]::Open($targetPath, [IO.FileMode]::Open,
156	                [IO.FileAccess]::Read, [IO.FileShare]::Delete)
157	            $stream = [IO.MemoryStream]::new()
158	            try {
159	                $guard.CopyTo($stream)
160	                [byte[]] $current = $stream.ToArray()
161	            } finally {
162	                $stream.Dispose()
163	            }

183	    }
184	    $true
185	}

1021-288-ClaudeHUD prefers the official statusline stdin payload for rate-limit windows. If `display.externalUsagePath` points to a fresh local sidecar snapshot, ClaudeHUD can append its `balance_label` alongside stdin windows. If stdin `rate_limits` are missing, the same snapshot can provide fallback usage windows.
1022-289-
1023-290:The fallback snapshot path must be absolute. The snapshot must be fresh enough (`display.externalUsageFreshnessMs`) and include valid `updated_at`, plus a `five_hour` window, `seven_day` window, `balance_label`, or `model_scoped` array. `balance_label` is optional text for prepaid provider balances; it is trimmed, length-limited, and sanitized before display. Relative paths, invalid JSON, stale files, or invalid timestamps are ignored quietly.
1024-291-
1025:292-The snapshot may also carry `model_scoped` windows using the same shape Claude Code defines for stdin (`display_name`, `utilization` on the 0-100 scale, ISO `resets_at`). They render exactly like stdin scoped windows (see the model-scoped usage section) and stdin always wins when it carries its own `model_scoped` data. This lets a local feeder surface per-model weekly quotas (e.g. Fable) that the statusline payload does not include yet:

# Context

The live `claude-hud` 0.8.0 configuration now uses Expanded layout, English labels, and maximum information, but the chezmoi bootstrap still documents and enforces the older Full 0.7.1 policy. A fresh machine would therefore receive most HUD settings but not the complete current configuration. The goal is to make the repo-generated base config reproduce the live 0.8.0 policy, explicitly preserve 0.8.0's per-config manual override, verify the bootstrap end to end, and commit only HUD-related work plus this session's SpecStory history on `main` without absorbing concurrent Copilot/Pueue/Herdr or staged statistics changes.

The plugin remains enabled. It contributes only two short discovery descriptions (`claude-hud:setup` and `claude-hud:configure`); their full bodies are lazy-loaded. No `skillOverrides` will be added because plugin-qualified overrides remain unreliable and disabling the plugin would weaken fresh-machine installation and updates.

# Implementation

1. **Upgrade the managed HUD base policy** — `claude/hud-full-overlay.json`
   - Keep all existing Full booleans and Git/Jujutsu settings.
   - Own the selected 0.8.0 presentation values: `language: "en"`, `lineLayout: "expanded"`, and `showSeparators: false`.
   - Enable `display.showRoutedCost`, `showSpeed`, `usageBarEnabled`, `showSessionStartDate`, and `showLastResponseAt`; explicitly keep `usageCompact: false`.
   - Leave custom text, auth/provider fields, ordering, colors, thresholds, time/model formatting, external usage paths, `effortFormat`, and unknown future keys user-owned.

2. **Update the merger identity without changing its safety model** — `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_25_claude_settings.ps1.tmpl`
   - Rename the diagnostic/write labels from Full 0.7.1 to Full 0.8.0.
   - Reuse the existing `Merge-JsonObject`, `Resolve-JsonTargetPath`, and `Write-JsonObjectAtomically` flow unchanged.
   - Continue managing only `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/plugins/claude-hud/config.json`; never create or edit `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/claude-hud.json`.

3. **Expand the ownership contract tests** — `tests/ClaudeSettings.Tests.ps1`
   - Rename Full 0.7.1 expectations to Full 0.8.0.
   - Assert the new owned true and false values from an empty config.
   - Seed opposite values for every newly owned leaf and prove the merger reasserts them while preserving representative advanced and unknown state.
   - Add a byte-for-byte preservation test for an existing `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/claude-hud.json`, while confirming the managed base config is still updated.
   - Retain existing idempotence, strict UTF-8, malformed-input, symlink, concurrency, and silent-no-cache coverage.

4. **Document the 0.8.0 policy and override layering**
   - Update `docs/tools.md` and `docs/tools.zh-TW.md` from Full 0.7.1 to Full 0.8.0, documenting Expanded/English/bar-style usage and the additional speed, routed-cost, session-start, and last-response indicators.
   - Update `docs/rationale.md` and `docs/rationale.zh-TW.md` to distinguish the chezmoi-managed shared base (`plugins/claude-hud/config.json`) from 0.8.0's untouched per-config override (`claude-hud.json`), which may intentionally shadow base values.
   - Preserve concurrent Herdr edits already present in the English/Traditional Chinese documentation worktree; include only HUD hunks in this commit.

5. **Preserve generated history and unrelated work**

+# Context
+
+Managed Windows machines currently force the company PyPI/uv and npm pull-through feeds. A redirected Azure Artifacts download returned HTTP 503 during `just docs-build`; there is no fallback, and changing `managedMachine=false` would also alter unrelated app-policy behavior (Grammarly/Tailscale). The package-source template also fails to clear repo-owned values when switching policies, so additive profile reloads can retain stale corporate/China endpoints.
+
+The goal is to keep `managedMachine` semantics intact, add a separate default-off authorization for narrowly scoped public fallback, and make package-source transitions convergent. Corporate remains the only first attempt; public is one explicit, isolated retry for approved transient failures. No global `uv`/`npm` shim, mixed indexes, or fallback for auth/TLS/policy/package-resolution failures.
+

+The managed claude-hud 0.8.0 policy currently shows context usage as a percentage only. claude-hud supports `display.contextValue: "both"`, which renders compact used/window tokens alongside the percentage (for example `45% (45k/200k)`) and falls back to percentage-only when the context-window size is unavailable. This follow-up will make that advanced value repo-owned, apply it safely to the live HUD base, verify rendering, and commit only the related config/tests/docs plus this plan and active chat history on `main`.
 
-The plugin remains enabled. It contributes only two short discovery descriptions (`claude-hud:setup` and `claude-hud:configure`); their full bodies are lazy-loaded. _**Agent (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-08-26 12:18:18Z)**_

兩邊不同主要是**歷史演進與平台工具鏈**，不是刻意選出兩套最佳實踐：

- `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` 先建立了 Ansible/Python 的 `claude_hud_sync.py`，因此能自行管理安裝、cache、registry 與更新。
- `dotfiles-windows` 後來採用 Claude Code 官方 marketplace/plugin manager，避免再維護一份 Windows 安裝器。

## 兩種方法比較

| 面向 | Plugin-native（Windows） | Direct sync（parent） |
|---|---|---|
| 實作複雜度 | **較低** | 較高，要維護 sync helper |
| 使用官方 plugin lifecycle | **是** | 部分繞過 |
| 新機器可預測性 | 首次啟動後才下載 | **apply 時就安裝完成** |
| 更新 | Marketplace auto-update 或 CLI | `just upgrade-plugins`，明確可控 |
| 版本控制 | 通常跟最新版 | 可明確抓取 release/tag |
| Plugin commands | 可用 `setup/configure` | disabled，不可用 |
| Context overhead | 兩個短 description | **零** |
| 對 Claude Code registry 格式的依賴 | 由官方處理 | Helper 必須跟進格式變更 |
| 維護成本 | **較低** | 較高 |

## 有顯著較好的做法嗎？

### 只看 context：差異不顯著

Windows 多出的只有兩個短 description，完整 skill/command body 是 lazy-loaded。省下來大約只是數十 tokens/session，不值得單獨為此維護安裝器。

### 看 dotfiles reproducibility：parent 做法較好

Parent 的方式有真正明顯的優點：

- `chezmoi apply`／Ansible 結束後 runtime 已存在。
- 不需要等第一次 Claude Code 啟動。
- 安裝和更新行為可測試。
- 更新是明確操作，不依賴第三方 marketplace 的 auto-update 狀態。
- Plugin cache 被清掉時可以重新建立。

### 看長期維護與相容性：Windows 做法較好

Plugin-native 不需要自行模擬：

- `installed_plugins.json`
- cache layout
- marketplace metadata
- Plugin registry schema
- Claude Code 未來的 plugin lifecycle 變化

Claude Code 若改內部格式，parent helper 可能需要修；官方 plugin manager 則會自行處理。

## 我的建議

**目前不值得只為 context overhead 把 Windows 改成 direct sync。**

推薦維持：

- Windows：plugin-native，保持 enabled。
- Parent：既有 direct sync，保持 disabled。
- 兩邊同步的是 **HUD config policy 與可見行為**，不是底層安裝機制。

如果要統一，我會選擇 **plugin-native 作為長期方向**，但需要先確認 Claude Code 能持久管理：

1. 第三方 marketplace auto-update。
2. 新機器首次安裝是否可靠。
3. 是否能可靠使用 `skillOverrides: user-invocable-only` 隱藏兩個 command descriptions。

目前第 3 點在近期版本仍有 plugin-qualified override 問題，所以現在強行統一反而會增加維護成本，沒有足夠收益。換言之：**兩邊現在的差異是合理的 platform-specific trade-off，不是必須立即消除的技術債。**

# dotfiles-windows

This machine's `$HOME` is managed by a **chezmoi** dotfiles repo targeting **native
Windows + PowerShell 7**. Packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI) —
there is no ansible here. Repo: <https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows>.
(macOS/Linux/WSL are handled by the separate `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` repo.)

## Orientation
- Source dir: `chezmoi source-path` — edit there (`cd "$(chezmoi source-path)"`).
- Preview / apply: `chezmoi diff` / `chezmoi apply` (or `just diff` / `just apply`).
- Source of a target: `chezmoi source-path <path>`; render without applying: `chezmoi cat <path>`.
- Re-run init prompts: `chezmoi init` (answers persist in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`).
- `docs/**`, `editors/**`, `scripts/**` are chezmoi-ignored (not deployed).

## Shell layout (pwsh)
- `$PROFILE` (`~/Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1`) is a loader
  that dot-sources `~/.config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in sorted order, then
  `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1` (untracked user override, loaded last).
- Fragments: `00_env` (PATH/XDG/env), `10_tools` (starship, zoxide, atuin,
  fzf, direnv, tv), `20_aliases` (`ll`/`gs`/`reload`/`cas`/`cau`/`chezmoi-cd`/`run-for`),
  `25_herdr` (`hvibe`/`hcode`/`hhere`/`hroot`/`hmark` workspace helpers, gated on herdr),
  `30_apps` (`applaunch`/`appquit`/`apprestart`/`sysvol`/`sysmute`/`x`), `35_yazi` (`y`),
  `40_copilot` (imports the Copilot module), `90_psreadline` (vi-mode gated on `enableVimMode`).

## Packages
- `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the **single source of
  truth** for installs, gated by the init toggles. scoop = CLI tools, winget = GUI
  apps, npm = AI agents, PSGallery = PSFzf/AudioDeviceCmdlets. Fault-tolerant: one
  failed package is collected + reported, never aborts the apply.
- Package sources are defined once in `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` and
  reused by the installer and `profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`: managed machines
  use company PyPI/npm pull-through registries; otherwise the China-mirror toggle
  selects GFW mirrors. Managed-machine policy wins if both toggles are true.
- Install ≠ upgrade: `chezmoi apply` only installs what's missing; upgrade via
  `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`.

## copilot-proxy
- Module at `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`. Commands: `copilot-proxy`
  (`start`/`stop`/`restart`/`status`/`doctor`/`logs`/`shim`/`whoami`/`auth`/`reinstall`),
  `copilot-run`, `claude-copilot`, `claude-copilot-once`, `codex-copilot`,
  `codex-copilot-once`, `copilot-here`, `copilot-model` (incl. `--auto`),
  `copilot-embed`, `semsearch`.
- Needs `bun`. Token: `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`. Ports 4141 (proxy) /
  4142 (throttle shim). Default main model `gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`; the OpenAI role
  profile maps Fable/Opus to Sol, Sonnet to Terra, and Haiku/background to Luna.
  Automatic selection excludes policy-disabled, picker-hidden and embedding-only
  entries. Claude `--auto` is Claude-first; Codex is OpenAI-first; both share the
  named OpenAI order Sol > Terra > 5.5 > 5.4 > 5.3 Codex > Luna > mini.
- The shim retries only the same buffered request/model, emits SSE keepalives for
  silent streams, and has a stall watchdog; it never performs request-time
  cross-model failover. Timing knobs: `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS`,
  `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS`, `COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS`.
- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `./.claude/settings.local.json`. The
  pinned copilot-api is installed ONCE into `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`
  (never `bunx` at launch); `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY` (auto|always|never|URL) controls
  whether Node fetches the GitHub model catalog through the local proxy. Full guide:
  `docs/copilot-proxy.md`.

## Editors / terminal / tv
- VSCode & Cursor settings + keybindings are deep-merged into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`
  by `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_20_editor_overlays.ps1.tmpl` (sources under `editors/`).
- Windows Terminal `profiles.defaults`, Alacritty (`%APPDATA%\alacritty\alacritty.toml`),
  and WezTerm (`~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua`, pwsh as default shell) are managed too.
  Television channels live under `%APPDATA%\television\cable\` (`tv <name>`).

## What's enabled on THIS machine
- role: **workstation**
- Coding agents: true · Agent sounds: peon · SpecStory build (PR #191): true · GUI apps: true · WSL2 (Docker backend): true · WSL Ubuntu: true · Utility apps: true · Gaming: true
- Extra runtimes: true · Media: true · LLM: true · Tunnel: true · IaC: true · OpenSSH: true · herdr: true · Clink(cmd): true · try: true · translate: true · Rime/Weasel: true
- China mirrors: true · Backup mode: smart · Vim mode: true · Managed machine: true

## just recipes
`just --list`: `apply`/`diff`/`update`, `upgrade-scoop`/`upgrade-winget`/`upgrade-translate`, `lint`/`test`,
`docs-serve`/`docs-build`, `enable-sshd` (opt-in OpenSSH server, elevated),
`enable-wsl` (WSL2 for Docker Desktop; self-elevating UAC prompt, reboot after),
`enable-wsl-ubuntu` (WSL2 Ubuntu distro + cross-platform dotfiles; needs enable-wsl first),
`wsl-dotfiles` (bootstrap the cross-platform dotfiles into an existing WSL distro; VPN if behind GFW),
`install-fonts-machine-wide` (Alacritty Nerd Font fix, elevated), and
`docker-up`/`docker-down`/`docker-clean`/`docker-logs`
(the x86-Linux+KVM Windows-in-Docker test harness — see `docker/windows/`).

## Gotchas
- Windows-only repo — no `{{ if eq .chezmoi.os }}` branching needed.
- Editor settings use a `run_onchange` pwsh merger (not `modify_`) on Windows.
- tmux / zellij are Unix-only and intentionally absent; **WezTerm** (installed) is
  the stable native tmux-like multiplexer, or use Windows Terminal panes. **herdr**
  is an opt-in (`installHerdr`) native-Windows multiplexer in preview beta —
  installed via herdr.dev's `irm|iex` script, config at `~/.config/herdr/config.toml`,
  with its official global skill exported from the installed binary on each apply.
  Runtimes are native via scoop (node/bun/go/rust/ruby) + uv for Python — no mise on Windows.
- **Rime input method** (opt-in `installInputMethod`): Weasel/小狼毫 via winget
  `Rime.Weasel`. Machine-scope NSIS, so applying raises UAC; and a bare silent
  install registers **简体** — `Install-Weasel` passes `--custom '/T'` for 繁體.
  The engine-level YAML in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` is **byte-identical to the
  parent repo's** copy (Squirrel/ibus-rime); only `weasel.custom.yaml` is
  Windows-specific. Edits need a redeploy, which
  `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
  See `docs/input-method.md`.
- **cmd.exe** is opt-in via `installClink`: Clink + starship/zoxide/fzf give the DOS
  prompt parity for **prompt + navigation only** (no pwsh funcs/aliases/modules).
  `starship.lua` is chezmoi-managed at `%LocalAppData%\clink`; the zoxide/fzf Clink
  bridges are fetched from upstream at apply. pwsh stays the default shell.
- **`translate`** (`installTranslate`, on for workstation) is the one tool built from
  source: no scoop/winget manifest, so the packages script runs a version-pinned
  `go install` into `~\.local\bin` (it installs `go` itself). First build takes
  minutes; re-applies no-op via a `--version` check. Upgrade with
  `just upgrade-translate`, not `upgrade-scoop`.
- This skill body is shared: `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/` and
  `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/` both render `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.


ARGUMENTS: 在 repo 現有 backlog/TODO 慣例中記錄未來評估統一 claude-hud 安裝架構（Windows plugin-native vs parent direct sync），然後在 main 做 focused commit，保留其他 dirty changes。

- Extra runtimes: true · Media: true · LLM: true · Tunnel: true · IaC: true · OpenSSH: true · herdr: true · Clink(cmd): true · try: true · translate: true · Rime/Weasel: true
- China mirrors: true · Backup mode: smart · Vim mode: true · Managed machine: true

## just recipes
`just --list`: `apply`/`diff`/`update`, `upgrade-scoop`/`upgrade-winget`/`upgrade-translate`, `lint`/`test`,
`docs-serve`/`docs-build`, `enable-sshd` (opt-in OpenSSH server, elevated),
`enable-wsl` (WSL2 for Docker Desktop; self-elevating UAC prompt, reboot after),
`enable-wsl-ubuntu` (WSL2 Ubuntu distro + cross-platform dotfiles; needs enable-wsl first),
`wsl-dotfiles` (bootstrap the cross-platform dotfiles into an existing WSL distro; VPN if behind GFW),
`install-fonts-machine-wide` (Alacritty Nerd Font fix, elevated), and
`docker-up`/`docker-down`/`docker-clean`/`docker-logs`
(the x86-Linux+KVM Windows-in-Docker test harness — see `docker/windows/`).

## Gotchas
- Windows-only repo — no `{{ if eq .chezmoi.os }}` branching needed.
- Editor settings use a `run_onchange` pwsh merger (not `modify_`) on Windows.
- tmux / zellij are Unix-only and intentionally absent; **WezTerm** (installed) is
  the stable native tmux-like multiplexer, or use Windows Terminal panes. **herdr**
  is an opt-in (`installHerdr`) native-Windows multiplexer in preview beta —
  installed via herdr.dev's `irm|iex` script, config at `~/.config/herdr/config.toml`,
  with its official global skill exported from the installed binary on each apply.
  Runtimes are native via scoop (node/bun/go/rust/ruby) + uv for Python — no mise on Windows.
- **Rime input method** (opt-in `installInputMethod`): Weasel/小狼毫 via winget
  `Rime.Weasel`. Machine-scope NSIS, so applying raises UAC; and a bare silent
  install registers **简体** — `Install-Weasel` passes `--custom '/T'` for 繁體.
  The engine-level YAML in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` is **byte-identical to the
  parent repo's** copy (Squirrel/ibus-rime); only `weasel.custom.yaml` is
  Windows-specific. Edits need a redeploy, which
  `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
  See `docs/input-method.md`.
- **cmd.exe** is opt-in via `installClink`: Clink + starship/zoxide/fzf give the DOS
  prompt parity for **prompt + navigation only** (no pwsh funcs/aliases/modules).
  `starship.lua` is chezmoi-managed at `%LocalAppData%\clink`; the zoxide/fzf Clink
  bridges are fetched from upstream at apply. pwsh stays the default shell.
- **`translate`** (`installTranslate`, on for workstation) is the one tool built from
  source: no scoop/winget manifest, so the packages script runs a version-pinned
  `go install` into `~\.local\bin` (it installs `go` itself). First build takes
  minutes; re-applies no-op via a `--version` check. Upgrade with
  `just upgrade-translate`, not `upgrade-scoop`.
- This skill body is shared: `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/` and
  `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/` both render `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) and other coding
4	agents when working with code in this repository. `CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to this file.
5	
6	## What this is
7	
8	Standalone, **Windows-only** dotfiles managed by [chezmoi](https://chezmoi.io),
9	targeting **PowerShell 7 (pwsh)**. It is a companion to the cross-platform
10	macOS/Linux repo `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` — the PowerShell layer is written
11	natively, **not** ported from that repo's POSIX shell config. No ansible;
12	packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI). Published at
13	`github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows`.
14	
15	**Dev box vs target:** the deploy target is Windows, but this checkout is usually
16	edited on macOS/Linux. You therefore **cannot execute the `.ps1` run-scripts
17	here** (they call winget / `%APPDATA%`). Validate with the isolated-apply +
18	render/parse pattern below; the `windows-latest` CI is the real gate.
19	
20	## Commands
21	
22	Real machine:

24	- `chezmoi apply` / `chezmoi diff` (or `just apply` / `just diff`)
25	- `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`
26	
27	Validate locally (needs a local pwsh, e.g. installed to `~/.local/bin/pwsh`):
28	
29	- Lint: `pwsh -NoProfile -c "Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Settings ./PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1"` (fails only on Error; the excludes are deliberate — see the settings file header)
30	- Tests: `pwsh -NoProfile -c "Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests"` (single file: `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/Copilot.Tests.ps1`)
31	- Docs: `just docs-build` (= `uv run --with mkdocs-material --with mkdocs-static-i18n mkdocs build --strict`)
32	
33	Isolated apply + template render (the core idiom for testing without a Windows
34	box — all chezmoi state is redirected to a temp dir, so it never touches your
35	real setup):
36	
37	```bash
38	TMPD=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$TMPD/home"
39	chezmoi init --source="$PWD" --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --persistent-state="$TMPD/s.db" \
40	  --destination="$TMPD/home" --no-tty \
41	  --promptChoice='Role: workstation (full desktop) or minimal (shell only)=minimal' \
42	  --promptString='Your full name (git)=T' --promptString='Your git email=t@e.com' ...  # EVERY prompt, exact text
43	chezmoi apply --source="$PWD" --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --persistent-state="$TMPD/s.db" \
44	  --destination="$TMPD/home" --exclude=scripts   # scripts can't run off-Windows
45	chezmoi execute-template --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --source="$PWD" < some.ps1.tmpl > r.ps1  # then parse r.ps1 with pwsh
46	```
47	
48	## Architecture (big picture)
49	
50	- **Init** — `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` `[data]` prompts once (`role` → coarse defaults, then `installX` toggles) and sets `[interpreters.ps1] = pwsh` so chezmoi runs `.ps1` scripts under pwsh. Prompts are hand-authored here (the parent repo generates them; this repo does not).
51	- **Shell** — `Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1` is a thin `$PROFILE` loader that dot-sources `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in numeric order (env → tool activation → aliases → apps/audio/clipboard → copilot import → yazi → tv cache → psreadline). Add a shell feature = a new numbered fragment. User overrides go in the untracked `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1`.
52	- **Packages** — `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the single source of truth for installs: scoop (CLI), winget (GUI), npm (AI agents), PSGallery (PSFzf / AudioDeviceCmdlets), all gated by init toggles. `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` owns persistent registry environment variables; `scripts/package-source-runner.ps1` owns command-scoped corporate-first fallback for the enumerated npm/uv operations. Managed machines use company PyPI/npm feeds; otherwise the China toggle selects GFW mirrors. Fault-tolerant (see invariants).
53	- **copilot-proxy** — `dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/` is a native PowerShell port of the parent's `43_copilot_proxy.sh` / `44_copilot_embed.sh` (runs the copilot-api fork so GitHub Copilot can back Claude Code and Codex). Reuses the Bun `copilot-throttle-shim.js` verbatim.
54	- **Config surfaces** — Alacritty (`AppData/Roaming/alacritty/`), Windows Terminal (a run_onchange that merges `profiles.defaults` non-destructively), WezTerm (`dot_config/wezterm/wezterm.lua` — sets pwsh as `default_prog`), editors (a run_onchange that deep-merges `editors/*.json` into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`), Claude Code (one `installCodingAgents`-gated, fail-closed run_onchange deep-merges settings and claude-hud Full config while preserving live/user-owned keys; see `docs/rationale.md`), Codex (`dot_codex/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl` fail-closed-merges only the native `tui.status_line` into `~/.codex/config.toml`, preserving providers/projects/plugins and gated on `installCodingAgents`), apprise desktop notifications (`dot_config/apprise/apprise.yaml` → `~/.config/apprise/`; the `windows://` toast backend behind the Claude notify hook `dot_claude/hooks/notify.ps1`, `installCodingAgents`-gated — the notify hook and peon-ping's voice-line hooks are both gated on the `agentSounds` tier (none|notify|peon|both) and built in the run_onchange, NOT in `claude/settings-overlay.json`; see docs/agent-sounds.md), television channels (`AppData/Roaming/television/`), starship + yazi (`~/.config`, yazi via `YAZI_CONFIG_HOME`), Rime/Weasel (see below), herdr (see below).
55	- **Rime input method** — `installInputMethod`-gated, and the one config surface **shared with the parent repo**. The engine-level YAML lives in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`default.custom.yaml`, `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml`) and is kept **byte-identical** to `daviddwlee84/dotfiles`'s copy of the same path — `diff -r` between the two dirs is the drift check, so edit one and copy to the other in the same session. Each platform is a one-line `{{ template "rime/…" . }}` renderer: `AppData/Roaming/Rime/` here, `private_Library/Rime/` (Squirrel) and `dot_config/ibus/rime/` (ibus-rime) there. Only `weasel.custom.yaml` is Windows-specific (`style/` is Weasel's own, `app_options` keys on the EXE name vs. Squirrel's bundle ids, and `global_ascii` doesn't exist on Squirrel). Plain managed files, **not** a `modify_` overlay: Rime persists runtime state to `user.yaml`, never back into `*.custom.yaml`. Two gotchas: a bare silent winget install registers **简体** (hence `--custom '/T'` in `Install-Weasel` — see `pitfalls/weasel-silent-install-registers-simplified-chinese.md`), and config edits need a redeploy, which `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
56	- **herdr** — `dot_config/herdr/` is deployed via `HERDR_CONFIG_PATH` and gated on `installHerdr`. `config.toml` is a **`modify_` overlay** (`modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl` + `.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml`), never a plain managed file: herdr rewrites that file at runtime (onboarding flag, `[session]`, `[remote]`, `[update]` bookkeeping) and a plain file clobbers it. The overlay enforces `[theme]`/`[ui]`/`[terminal]`/`[keys]` wholesale, pulls every other top-level key through, and re-asserts the single key `update.channel = "preview"` (the Windows installer rejects `stable`). `run_after_15_sync_herdr_skill.ps1.tmpl` exports the exact installed binary's `herdr --skill` output to real copies under both `~/.agents/skills/herdr/` and `~/.claude/skills/herdr/`; no symlink/junction is used. Helper-script paths in the keymap are baked **absolute at render time** — `pwsh -File` does not expand `~`. Six pwsh helpers (`_common.ps1` + run-command / new-tab-at-space-root / url-pick / path-pick / pane-copy / review-mark) back the `[[keys.command]]` bindings; three `herdr-*` tv channels and the herdr-plus quick-actions are gated by the same toggle. Ported from the parent repo 2026-07-27; the behaviours that still need a real Windows box are listed in [`backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md`](backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md).
57	- **git config** — `~/.gitconfig` is a **`modify_` overlay** (`modify_dot_gitconfig.ps1.tmpl`), never a plain managed file: Git Credential Manager writes `[credential "azrepos:*"]` blocks into it out of band and a plain file would clobber them every apply. The baseline body is `.chezmoitemplates/git/gitconfig` (identity from the existing `.name`/`.email` init prompts); the merge engine is `scripts/gitconfig-merge.ps1`, inlined via `{{ include }}` (the `editors/` idiom) and dot-sourced by `tests/GitConfig.Tests.ps1`. The model is **key-level pull-through**: the baseline owns a fixed set of `section.key` pairs and every other live key is carried over untouched — the inverse of the parent repo's allowlist, which would silently drop `[otel]` and future corp sections. Two hard rules: `core.hooksPath` is **never** emitted (git honours it *instead of* `.git/hooks/`, silently disarming `pre-commit`), and the carry dictionary is **case-sensitive** (`[ordered]@{}` collapses `azrepos:org/O365Exchange` into `azrepos:org/o365exchange`, merging two credential contexts).
58	- **Docs** — bilingual mkdocs-material (`docs/X.md` + `docs/X.zh-TW.md`), deployed to GitHub Pages by `.github/workflows/docs.yml`. `docs/rationale.md` records the design choices (scoop > Chocolatey, starship > oh-my-posh, pwsh > cmd, native pwsh tree > ported shell layer).
59	- **CI** — `.github/workflows/windows.yml` on `windows-latest` is the real gate: PSScriptAnalyzer, non-interactive `chezmoi init --apply`, render+parse of every `.ps1.tmpl`, and Pester.
60	
61	## Conventions & hard invariants
62	
63	1. **A new/renamed init prompt must update the CI flags in the same commit.** `chezmoi init --promptBool/--promptChoice "<text>=value"` matches the prompt's exact TEXT (3rd arg to `promptXOnce` in `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`), used non-interactively by `.github/workflows/windows.yml`. Forget it → CI's init hangs/EOFs (`error calling promptChoiceOnce: EOF`; this broke three consecutive pushes when `agentSounds` was added). Corollary: **never put `=` in a prompt's text** — the `name=value` parser splits on the first `=` (this broke the `role` prompt once). Enforced by `tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` (missing flag, stale flag, wrong flag kind, `=` in text), which CI runs *before* `chezmoi init` so the failure names the missing flag instead of EOF-ing — run `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` locally after touching either file.
64	2. **Run-scripts must never abort the apply.** The installer + editor/terminal/backup/skill scripts use `$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'` (+ `PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=$false`), collect failures via `Register-Failure`, print a summary, and exit 0. One bad scoop/winget manifest (e.g. btop's stale `.conf`) must not stop the rest.
65	3. **Preserve raw escapes when authoring config with control chars.** Alacritty CSI-u (`[…u`), VSCode `sendSequence`, tv `\t` — hand-typing tends to drop them. Generate via a throwaway Python script and re-parse (`tomllib` / `json`) to confirm the escape landed.
66	4. **tv channel commands are `pwsh -NoProfile -Command "…"` inside TOML literal (`'''…'''`) strings** — runs regardless of tv's shell, sidesteps nested-quote escaping; placeholders `{split: :0}` (space) / `{split:\t:0}` (tab). tv reads config from `%APPDATA%\television\` on Windows.
67	5. **Editors use a run_onchange pwsh merger, not `modify_`** (`modify_` interpreter selection is unreliable on Windows). Overlay sources live in `editors/` (chezmoi-ignored, embedded via `{{ include }}`).
68	6. **The agent skill body lives once** in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`; both `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` and `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` render it via `{{ "{{" }} template … {{ "}}" }}` → real files at `~/.agents/skills/` and `~/.claude/skills/`. Edit the shared template, not the two one-line renderers (no symlink/junction — those need elevation/Developer Mode on Windows).
69	7. **PSScriptAnalyzer exclusions are intentional** (`PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1`): hyphenated command names, `Write-Host`, `Invoke-Expression` for tool init, no-BOM UTF-8. Don't "fix" these; do fix real Errors.
70	8. **Public package fallback is opt-in, deny-first, and single-source.** Only repo-owned npm agent operations and uv dependency resolution may use `scripts/package-source-runner.ps1`; corporate is always attempted first and public at most once. Never add public as an extra index, broaden fallback beyond timeout/transient-network/HTTP-5xx, or bypass 401/403, TLS/certificate, package-absence, policy, solver/build, or local-state failures. Go/Rust/Ruby/Scoop/winget/Git/CDN operations have no corporate source and must not use this fallback.
71	
72	### Cross-file mirrors (same commit)
73	
74	- New installer tool → `docs/tools.md` **and** `docs/tools.zh-TW.md`.
75	- New init prompt → `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` + `windows.yml` flags + `docs/setup.md`/`setup.zh-TW.md` tables + the "What's enabled" block in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.
76	- New `docs/**/*.md` → its `.zh-TW.md` twin + `nav` + `nav_translations` in `mkdocs.yml`; `just docs-build` must stay green.
77	- Any edit under `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` → copy the file verbatim into the parent repo's `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`chezmoi source-path` there, usually `~/.local/share/chezmoi`). They must stay byte-identical; verify with `diff -r`. Frontend-only changes (`weasel.custom.yaml`) do **not** cross over.
78	- `dot_config/powershell/copilot-throttle-shim.js` is copied verbatim from the parent repo's `dot_config/shell/copilot-throttle-shim.js`. Update both in the same maintenance session, then update the reviewed Unix source commit + SHA-256 contract in `tests/Copilot.Tests.ps1`; the Windows test must remain runnable without a sibling checkout.
79	- `core.autocrlf = input` has **two writers** — `bootstrap.ps1` (runs before chezmoi exists, so scoop's first bucket clone is protected) and `.chezmoitemplates/git/gitconfig` (the managed baseline). Change one → change the other.
80	
81	### `scripts/*.sh` are wrappers, not implementations
82	
83	`scripts/{add-todo,todo-kanban,promote-todo,sweep-inbox}.sh` are byte-identical
84	three-line shims. The real code is vendored at
85	`.agents/skills/project-knowledge-harness/scripts/<same-name>.sh`, and each
86	wrapper derives its target from `$0`, so adding a new helper only needs a copy
87	of an existing wrapper under the new name.
88	
89	They exist because the skill documents its helpers with cwd-relative paths
90	(`scripts/add-todo.sh`) and that prose was copied verbatim into the guidance
91	block below — where `scripts/` means *this* directory. Fixing the prose instead
92	would not survive, because `project-knowledge-harness` regenerates everything
93	between its sentinel markers. **This note is deliberately above the opening
94	sentinel so regeneration cannot erase it.**
95	
96	Not symlinks — invariant 6 (symlinks/junctions need elevation or Developer
97	Mode on Windows).
98	
99	<!-- project-knowledge-harness:agent-guidance -->
100	<!-- Snippet for the project's agent contract file (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md /
101	     similar). The bundled scripts/init.sh appends this between sentinel
102	     markers; safe to re-run. -->
103	
104	### Long-term backlog → `TODO.md` + `backlog/`
105	
106	When the user surfaces an idea explicitly **not** being implemented this
107	session (signals: "maybe later", "nice to have", "if I'm interested",
108	"工程量太大需要再評估", "先記下來"), add an entry to [`TODO.md`](TODO.md) using
109	the priority + effort tag schema. Do **not** create new `ROADMAP.md` /
110	`IDEAS.md` / `BACKLOG.md` files — `TODO.md` is the single index.
111	
112	The bundled `scripts/todo-kanban.sh` validates the format. Run it
113	(`scripts/todo-kanban.sh --validate-only TODO.md`) after editing so syntax
114	drift is caught immediately.
115	
116	#### Three ways to add a TODO entry (preferred order)
117	
118	1. **Structured CLI — `scripts/add-todo.sh`** (default):
119	
120	   ```
121	   scripts/add-todo.sh --priority P3 --effort M \
122	     --title "Title" --description "Description"
123	   ```
124	
125	   Inserts a canonically-formatted line into the right `## P*` lane and
126	   re-runs the validator. Add `--backlog` to also scaffold
127	   `backlog/<slug>.md` from the bundled template.
128	
129	2. **Quick capture — `backlog/inbox.md`** (when priority/effort unclear):
130	
131	   ```
132	   echo "- maybe add docs versioning with mike" >> backlog/inbox.md
133	   ```
134	
135	   When the user asks "sweep the inbox", run
136	   `scripts/sweep-inbox.sh`. It prompts for the missing fields per loose
137	   line and calls `add-todo.sh`. Use `--batch` for non-interactive runs
138	   that only formalize lines with parseable `key=value` pairs.
139	
140	3. **Direct edit of `TODO.md`** — fine if the format is fresh; run
141	   `scripts/todo-kanban.sh --validate-only` afterwards.
142	
143	Add a `backlog/<slug>.md` companion doc when the item meets any of:
144	
145	- carries a `P?` tag (record what was tried so it doesn't need re-investigation)
146	- captures a paused troubleshooting session that you intend to fix later
147	  (preserve the error trace + root cause analysis before context evaporates)
148	- weighs multiple options (record trade-offs, not only the winner)
149	- is `[L]` or `[XL]` (architectural; needs design before code)
150	
151	`[S]` items rarely need a backlog doc — a file path in the `TODO.md` line is
152	usually enough. See [`backlog/README.md`](backlog/README.md) for the full
153	template and "when to add a doc" rules.
154	
155	When implementing a `TODO.md` item, in the same commit:
156	
157	1. Run `scripts/promote-todo.sh --title "<substring>" --summary "<what shipped>"`
158	   to move the entry into `## Done` with the dated syntax and re-validate.
159	2. Mark the corresponding `backlog/<slug>.md` (if any) `Status: shipped`
160	   and keep it as a historical record (don't delete — future-you may
161	   revisit adjacent decisions).
162	
163	`backlog/` is excluded from chezmoi (see .chezmoiignore); it
164	is repo metadata for maintainers, not user-facing config to deploy.
165	
166	### Past pitfalls → `pitfalls/`
167	
168	When you spend more than ~15 minutes debugging something that wasn't
169	googleable and the fix is non-obvious, write a `pitfalls/<slug>.md`
170	capturing:
171	
172	1. **Verbatim symptom** — copy-paste error messages exactly, do not
173	   paraphrase (preserves grep-ability for future-you / future agent)
174	2. **Root cause** — why this happens (with source / docs / upstream issue link)
175	3. **Workaround** — copy-pasteable commands or config diff
176	4. **Prevention** — how to avoid stepping on this again
177	
178	Title the doc by the **symptom**, not the root cause (you'll search by what
179	you're seeing, not by what you eventually learned). See
180	[`pitfalls/README.md`](pitfalls/README.md) for the full template and
181	when-to-add rules.
182	
183	**Pitfall vs Hard invariant**: a pitfall *graduates* to a Hard invariant in
184	this file when it (a) recurs across machines/agents/sessions despite being
185	documented, (b) silently corrupts state, or (c) the workaround is non-obvious
186	enough that "remember to do X" isn't safe. When graduating, leave the
187	`pitfalls/<slug>.md` as historical record and link to it from the new
188	invariant.
189	
190	`pitfalls/` is excluded from chezmoi (see .chezmoiignore) and
191	**not** auto-redacted; review for secrets before committing.

1	# Align Windows backup with Unix: run_before + unified dir
2	
3	**Status**: P?
4	**Effort**: S
5	**Related**: `TODO.md` · `.chezmoiscripts/run_once_before_01_backup.ps1.tmpl` · Unix repo `run_before_01_backup_dotfiles.sh.tmpl`
6	
7	## Context
8	
9	2026-07, surfaced while comparing the Windows `bootstrap.ps1` install path
10	against the Unix `get.chezmoi.io` one-liner. Both repos carry a pre-apply
11	backup run-script, but they are **not behaviorally equivalent**, and the
12	divergence means the Windows side offers weaker ongoing protection.
13	
14	## Investigation
15	
16	Two differences confirmed by reading both scripts:
17	
18	1. **Trigger frequency.**
19	   - Unix: `run_before_01_backup_dotfiles.sh.tmpl` — `run_before_` fires
20	     **before every `chezmoi apply`**, with a daily-dedup guard, and uses
21	     `chezmoi status` "smart" mode to back up only files whose col2 ∈ {M,D}
22	     (about to be overwritten/deleted). Ongoing protection on every apply.
23	   - Windows: `.chezmoiscripts/run_once_before_01_backup.ps1.tmpl` —
24	     `run_once_before_` fires **only on the first apply** (or when the script
25	     content hash changes). After the initial snapshot, editing a local file
26	     and re-applying does **not** back it up. This is the real gap.
27	
28	2. **Selection strategy.**
29	   - Unix: smart (status-driven) vs full (fixed allowlist) vs off.
30	   - Windows: fixed target allowlist only (smart == full); no status-driven
31	     selection. Allowlist currently:
32	     `Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1`,
33	     `.config/powershell`, `.config/starship.toml`,
34	     `%APPDATA%/alacritty/alacritty.toml`,
35	     `%APPDATA%/{Code,Cursor}/User/settings.json`.
36	
37	3. **Backup dir naming inconsistency.**
38	   - Unix writes to `~/.dotfiles_backup` (underscore).
39	   - Windows writes to `~/.dotfiles-backup` (hyphen).
40	
41	## Options considered
42	
43	| Option | Pros | Cons |
44	|---|---|---|
45	| A. Rename `run_once_before_` → `run_before_` on Windows | Every-apply protection, matches Unix intent | `chezmoi status` parsing in PowerShell needed for true smart mode; more work per apply |
46	| B. Keep `run_once_`, just unify dir name | Trivial, low risk | Leaves the first-apply-only gap unaddressed |
47	| C. Full parity: `run_before_` + PowerShell `chezmoi status` smart-select + unified dir | Real cross-platform symmetry | Most effort; must parse status output & map target paths on Windows |
48	
49	## Current blocker / open questions
50	
51	- Is every-apply backup actually wanted on Windows, or is first-apply-only an
52	  intentional lighter-touch choice? Need user preference before picking A/C.
53	- If going smart: does `chezmoi status` output on Windows map cleanly from
54	  relpath → on-disk target for the parse loop (APPDATA-rooted targets aren't
55	  under `$HOME`)?
56	- Dir rename: pick one name for both repos (`~/.dotfiles-backup` reads better;
57	  Unix uses underscore) — renaming Unix side touches the other repo.
58	
59	## Decision (if any)
60	
61	None yet — logged for later. Lowest-risk slice is Option B (dir-name unify);
62	full value is Option C.
63	
64	## References
65	
66	- Windows backup: `.chezmoiscripts/run_once_before_01_backup.ps1.tmpl`
67	- Unix backup: `run_before_01_backup_dotfiles.sh.tmpl` (repo `daviddwlee84/dotfiles`)
68	- chezmoi run-script ordering: https://www.chezmoi.io/reference/target-types/#scripts
69
```

1	# Backlog Research
2	
3	Long-form research, design notes, and paused troubleshooting for items listed in
4	[`../TODO.md`](../TODO.md). One file per topic, named with a slug that matches
5	the TODO entry.
6	
7	## Why this exists
8	
9	`TODO.md` is the **index** — short titles grouped by priority section with
10	effort tags. This folder
11	is the **knowledge base** — the actual investigation, options considered,
12	benchmarks, error messages, and decisions that informed the TODO entry. The goal
13	is **resume-friendliness**: when you (or an agent) come back to an item three
14	months later, the doc here lets you pick up in 5 minutes instead of re-running
15	30 minutes of investigation.
16	
17	This folder is excluded from <DEPLOYMENT/PACKAGING MECHANISM, e.g. chezmoi via
18	.chezmoiignore.tmpl> — it is repo metadata for maintainers, not user-facing
19	config to deploy.
20	
21	## When to add a doc here
22	
23	Add a `backlog/<slug>.md` file when **any** of these apply:
24	
25	- The TODO item carries a `P?` tag (it requires evaluation; record what was tried)
26	- You did meaningful troubleshooting but didn't ship a fix (capture the trace
27	  before it evaporates)
28	- Multiple options were considered (record the trade-offs, not just the winner)
29	- An external blocker exists (waiting on upstream release, host availability)
30	- The implementation is `[L]` or `[XL]` (architectural; needs design before code)
31	
32	`[S]` items rarely need a doc unless there's surprising context.
33	
34	## When NOT to add a doc here
35	
36	- Item is `[S]` and obvious — just put the file path in the TODO entry
37	- Already covered by an existing doc page (cross-link instead — that's
38	  user-facing reference, this is maintainer-facing speculation)
39	- Speculation only ("would be cool to...") with no investigation — keep it as a
40	  one-liner in `TODO.md` first; promote to a doc when you actually look into it
41	
42	## File template
43	
44	See [`backlog-doc.md.template`] in the skill's `assets/` for the per-doc
45	template, or copy the structure of an existing entry below.
46	
47	## Index
48

+兩邊不同主要是**歷史演進與平台工具鏈**，不是刻意選出兩套最佳實踐：
+
+- `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` 先建立了 Ansible/Python 的 `claude_hud_sync.py`，因此能自行管理安裝、cache、registry 與更新。
+- `dotfiles-windows` 後來採用 Claude Code 官方 marketplace/plugin manager，避免再維護一份 Windows 安裝器。
+
+## 兩種方法比較
+
+| 面向 | Plugin-native（Windows） | Direct sync（parent） |
+|---|---|---|
+| 實作複雜度 | **較低** | 較高，要維護 sync helper |
+| 使用官方 plugin lifecycle | **是** | 部分繞過 |
+| 新機器可預測性 | 首次啟動後才下載 | **apply 時就安裝完成** |
+| 更新 | Marketplace auto-update 或 CLI | `just upgrade-plugins`，明確可控 |
+| 版本控制 | 通常跟最新版 | 可明確抓取 release/tag |
+| Plugin commands | 可用 `setup/configure` | disabled，不可用 |
+| Context overhead | 兩個短 description | **零** |
+| 對 Claude Code registry 格式的依賴 | 由官方處理 | Helper 必須跟進格式變更 |
+| 維護成本 | **較低** | 較高 |
+
+## 有顯著較好的做法嗎？
+
+### 只看 context：差異不顯著
+
+Windows 多出的只有兩個短 description，完整 skill/command body 是 lazy-loaded。省下來大約只是數十 tokens/session，不值得單獨為此維護安裝器。
+
+### 看 dotfiles reproducibility：parent 做法較好
+
+Parent 的方式有真正明顯的優點：
+
+- `chezmoi apply`／Ansible 結束後 runtime 已存在。
+- 不需要等第一次 Claude Code 啟動。
+- 安裝和更新行為可測試。
+- 更新是明確操作，不依賴第三方 marketplace 的 auto-update 狀態。
+- Plugin cache 被清掉時可以重新建立。
+
+### 看長期維護與相容性：Windows 做法較好
+
+Plugin-native 不需要自行模擬：
+
+- `installed_plugins.json`
+- cache layout
+- marketplace metadata
+- Plugin registry schema
+- Claude Code 未來的 plugin lifecycle 變化
+
+Claude Code 若改內部格式，parent helper 可能需要修；官方 plugin manager 則會自行處理。
+
+## 我的建議
+
+**目前不值得只為 context overhead 把 Windows 改成 direct sync。**
+
+推薦維持：
+
+- Windows：plugin-native，保持 enabled。
+- Parent：既有 direct sync，保持 disabled。
+- 兩邊同步的是 **HUD config policy 與可見行為**，不是底層安裝機制。
+
+如果要統一，我會選擇 **plugin-native 作為長期方向**，但需要先確認 Claude Code 能持久管理：

+1. 第三方 marketplace auto-update。
+2. 新機器首次安裝是否可靠。
+3. 是否能可靠使用 `skillOverrides: user-invocable-only` 隱藏兩個 command descriptions。

+目前第 3 點在近期版本仍有 plugin-qualified override 問題，所以現在強行統一反而會增加維護成本，沒有足夠收益。換言之：**兩邊現在的差異是合理的 platform-specific trade-off，不是必須立即消除的技術債。**

+Base directory for this skill: C:\Users\hanruzhou\.claude\skills\dotfiles-windows

+# dotfiles-windows
+
+This machine's `$HOME` is managed by a **chezmoi** dotfiles repo targeting **native
+Windows + PowerShell 7**. Packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI) —
+there is no ansible here. Repo: <https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows>.
+(macOS/Linux/WSL are handled by the separate `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` repo.)
+
+## Orientation
+- Source dir: `chezmoi source-path` — edit there (`cd "$(chezmoi source-path)"`).
+- Preview / apply: `chezmoi diff` / `chezmoi apply` (or `just diff` / `just apply`).
+- Source of a target: `chezmoi source-path <path>`; render without applying: `chezmoi cat <path>`.
+- Re-run init prompts: `chezmoi init` (answers persist in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`).
+- `docs/**`, `editors/**`, `scripts/**` are chezmoi-ignored (not deployed).
+
+## Shell layout (pwsh)
+- `$PROFILE` (`~/Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1`) is a loader
+  that dot-sources `~/.config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in sorted order, then
+  `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1` (untracked user override, loaded last).
+- Fragments: `00_env` (PATH/XDG/env), `10_tools` (starship, zoxide, atuin,
+  fzf, direnv, tv), `20_aliases` (`ll`/`gs`/`reload`/`cas`/`cau`/`chezmoi-cd`/`run-for`),
+  `25_herdr` (`hvibe`/`hcode`/`hhere`/`hroot`/`hmark` workspace helpers, gated on herdr),
+  `30_apps` (`applaunch`/`appquit`/`apprestart`/`sysvol`/`sysmute`/`x`), `35_yazi` (`y`),
+  `40_copilot` (imports the Copilot module), `90_psreadline` (vi-mode gated on `enableVimMode`).
+
+## Packages
+- `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the **single source of
+  truth** for installs, gated by the init toggles. scoop = CLI tools, winget = GUI
+  apps, npm = AI agents, PSGallery = PSFzf/AudioDeviceCmdlets. Fault-tolerant: one
+  failed package is collected + reported, never aborts the apply.
+- Package sources are defined once in `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` and
+  reused by the installer and `profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`: managed machines
+  use company PyPI/npm pull-through registries; otherwise the China-mirror toggle
+  selects GFW mirrors. Managed-machine policy wins if both toggles are true.
+- Install ≠ upgrade: `chezmoi apply` only installs what's missing; upgrade via
+  `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`.
+
+## copilot-proxy
+- Module at `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`. Commands: `copilot-proxy`
+  (`start`/`stop`/`restart`/`status`/`doctor`/`logs`/`shim`/`whoami`/`auth`/`reinstall`),
+  `copilot-run`, `claude-copilot`, `claude-copilot-once`, `codex-copilot`,
+  `codex-copilot-once`, `copilot-here`, `copilot-model` (incl. `--auto`),
+  `copilot-embed`, `semsearch`.
+- Needs `bun`. Token: `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`. Ports 4141 (proxy) /
+  4142 (throttle shim). Default main model `gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`; the OpenAI role
+  profile maps Fable/Opus to Sol, Sonnet to Terra, and Haiku/background to Luna.
+  Automatic selection excludes policy-disabled, picker-hidden and embedding-only
+  entries. Claude `--auto` is Claude-first; Codex is OpenAI-first; both share the
+  named OpenAI order Sol > Terra > 5.5 > 5.4 > 5.3 Codex > Luna > mini.
+- The shim retries only the same buffered request/model, emits SSE keepalives for
+  silent streams, and has a stall watchdog; it never performs request-time
+  cross-model failover. Timing knobs: `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS`,
+  `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS`, `COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS`.
+- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `./.claude/settings.local.json`. The
+  pinned copilot-api is installed ONCE into `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`
+  (never `bunx` at launch); `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY` (auto|always|never|URL) controls
+  whether Node fetches the GitHub model catalog through the local proxy. Full guide:
+  `docs/copilot-proxy.md`.
+
+## Editors / terminal / tv
+- VSCode & Cursor settings + keybindings are deep-merged into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`
+  by `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_20_editor_overlays.ps1.tmpl` (sources under `editors/`).
+- Windows Terminal `profiles.defaults`, Alacritty (`%APPDATA%\alacritty\alacritty.toml`),
+  and WezTerm (`~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua`, pwsh as default shell) are managed too.
+  Television channels live under `%APPDATA%\television\cable\` (`tv <name>`).
+
+## What's enabled on THIS machine
+- role: **workstation**
+- Coding agents: true · Agent sounds: peon · SpecStory build (PR #191): true · GUI apps: true · WSL2 (Docker backend): true · WSL Ubuntu: true · Utility apps: true · Gaming: true
+- Extra runtimes: true · Media: true · LLM: true · Tunnel: true · IaC: true · OpenSSH: true · herdr: true · Clink(cmd): true · try: true · translate: true · Rime/Weasel: true
+- China mirrors: true · Backup mode: smart · Vim mode: true · Managed machine: true
+
+## just recipes
+`just --list`: `apply`/`diff`/`update`, `upgrade-scoop`/`upgrade-winget`/`upgrade-translate`, `lint`/`test`,
+`docs-serve`/`docs-build`, `enable-sshd` (opt-in OpenSSH server, elevated),
+`enable-wsl` (WSL2 for Docker Desktop; self-elevating UAC prompt, reboot after),
+`enable-wsl-ubuntu` (WSL2 Ubuntu distro + cross-platform dotfiles; needs enable-wsl first),
+`wsl-dotfiles` (bootstrap the cross-platform dotfiles into an existing WSL distro; VPN if behind GFW),
+`install-fonts-machine-wide` (Alacritty Nerd Font fix, elevated), and
+`docker-up`/`docker-down`/`docker-clean`/`docker-logs`
+(the x86-Linux+KVM Windows-in-Docker test harness — see `docker/windows/`).
+
+## Gotchas
+- Windows-only repo — no `{{ if eq .chezmoi.os }}` branching needed.
+- Editor settings use a `run_onchange` pwsh merger (not `modify_`) on Windows.
+- tmux / zellij are Unix-only and intentionally absent; **WezTerm** (installed) is
+  the stable native tmux-like multiplexer, or use Windows Terminal panes. **herdr**
+  is an opt-in (`installHerdr`) native-Windows multiplexer in preview beta —
+  installed via herdr.dev's `irm|iex` script, config at `~/.config/herdr/config.toml`,
+  with its official global skill exported from the installed binary on each apply.
+  Runtimes are native via scoop (node/bun/go/rust/ruby) + uv for Python — no mise on Windows.
+- **Rime input method** (opt-in `installInputMethod`): Weasel/小狼毫 via winget
+  `Rime.Weasel`. Machine-scope NSIS, so applying raises UAC; and a bare silent
+  install registers **简体** — `Install-Weasel` passes `--custom '/T'` for 繁體.
+  The engine-level YAML in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` is **byte-identical to the
+  parent repo's** copy (Squirrel/ibus-rime); only `weasel.custom.yaml` is
+  Windows-specific. Edits need a redeploy, which
+  `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
+  See `docs/input-method.md`.
+- **cmd.exe** is opt-in via `installClink`: Clink + starship/zoxide/fzf give the DOS
+  prompt parity for **prompt + navigation only** (no pwsh funcs/aliases/modules).
+  `starship.lua` is chezmoi-managed at `%LocalAppData%\clink`; the zoxide/fzf Clink
+  bridges are fetched from upstream at apply. pwsh stays the default shell.
+- **`translate`** (`installTranslate`, on for workstation) is the one tool built from
+  source: no scoop/winget manifest, so the packages script runs a version-pinned
+  `go install` into `~\.local\bin` (it installs `go` itself). First build takes
+  minutes; re-applies no-op via a `--version` check. Upgrade with
+  `just upgrade-translate`, not `upgrade-scoop`.
+- This skill body is shared: `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/` and
+  `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/` both render `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.
+

## How to read this

Each item carries two tags:

- **Priority**: `P1` (next likely batch) · `P2` (worth doing) · `P3` (someday) · `P?` (needs evaluation first — spike before committing)
- **Effort**: `S` (< 1h) · `M` (half day) · `L` (multi-day) · `XL` (architectural, design doc first)

A trailing `→ [research](backlog/<slug>.md)` link means the item has accompanying
investigation, design notes, or paused troubleshooting — read that first before
re-investigating. Items without a link are simple enough to act on directly.

with a one-line summary of what shipped.

<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Inspect parent direct sync helper
